title: IntentGraph Ralph task list
description: Schema for automation/tasks/<phase>/tasks.json. ralph.sh validates every task list against this before any iteration runs.

_banner.description: Free-form banner / status note for human readers. Optional. Underscore-prefixed by convention; not consumed by ralph.sh.

phase.description: Slug matching the directory name. Must align with tech-spec.md §6 phase headings.

status.description: Lifecycle. ralph.sh refuses to execute anything but `approved` or `executing`.

approved_by.description: Output of `git config user.name` at approval time.

git_commit_hash.description: Hash of the commit that flipped status to approved.

approval.description: Required when status is `approved`. See APPROVAL.md for the flow.

max_total_cost_usd.description: Hard cap is 200; ralph.sh enforces this regardless of the value here. Raise above the default only with a justification in the docstring.

max_total_cost_usd_justification.description: Required if max_total_cost_usd > 100. Explains why this phase needs more budget.

required_commands.description: Shell commands that must all exit 0 before a task is considered complete.

phase_specific_checks.description: Additional shell commands run after required_commands, scoped to this phase.

required.description: When true, the monitor-llm gate runs after every task and a `block`/`require_human_review` verdict halts the loop. Mandatory for phases 4 and 6.

model.description: Groq model id. Default per tech-spec.md §4.

scope_files.description: Glob patterns the task is allowed to touch. ralph.sh does not enforce this directly but logs violations for human review.

spec_reference.description: Pointer into tech-spec.md or an ADR. Format: `tech-spec.md#section-N` or `docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md`.

completion_signal.description: Token the agent must emit verbatim in its final output to signal task complete.

estimated_minutes.description: Sanity check. Tasks expected to take >30 minutes should be split.

human_checkpoint.description: When true, the loop refuses to execute this task without an entry in the sibling approvals.json.

blocked_on_decision.description: When non-null, the task is blocked pending the named decision (typically an ADR). ralph.sh skips and reports.

notes.description: Free-form context for the human reviewer.
